posts.title: The Long Beard of Doctor Visser
posts.excerpt: A retired doctor in Delfshaven decides to grow the longest beard in the country, and his whole street gets involved.
posts.content:
Anna Kruit, €24.95, hardback

A retired doctor in Delfshaven decides to grow the longest beard in the country, and his whole street gets involved. It is very funny for two hundred pages and then it isn't. I've sold eleven and I want to sell a hundred.
